messages:
carla: Quick run-through: Surfline agreed to a short case study. Need: signed approval email, one verified metric, headshot + logo, and a 2-sentence customer quote.
diego: I scheduled a 20-min call Thurs 11am PT with Priya (Eng Lead). Sent Qs.
marta: Ill draft narrative. Key asks: p99 tail and cost-per-inference impact.
leo: I can pull telemetry. Suggest last 14 days post-rollout for clean numbers.
carla: For social use percent, for case page include absolute numbers. Example: "p99 from 490ms to 128ms (74% reduction); cost per inference -35%". Confirm with customer.
terry-legal: If we publish exact metrics with company name, need a signed approval line. Ill post a one-paragraph template you must use.
diego: Priya OK with time; asked for questions in advance. Forwarded draft quote and metrics, requested approval per Terrys template.
assets-bot: Noted preferred formats. Will create assets folder when files arrive.
leo: Pulled numbers: post p99=128ms, pre p99=490ms, cost/inference $0.0031 -> $0.0020 (~35% drop). Rounding prepared for customer-facing copy.
marta: Internal draft quote: "Redwood Dedicated gave us predictable tail latency and cost efficiency to scale real-time personalization." Thoughts?
carla: Love it. Attribute to Priya, Eng Lead, Surfline. Send precise stat to Priya; allow relaxed language for social if they prefer.
terry-legal: Sent approval template: "I, [NAME], on behalf of [COMPANY], approve the following quote and metrics for Redwood Inference marketing: [QUOTE] [METRICS]." Use verbatim.
diego: Priya sent approval email with template copy-pasted. Forwarded to Terry.
terry-legal: Received. Clause check OK. No red flags. Cleared to publish.
assets-bot: Uploaded placeholder banner. Will export hero/headshot/logo once customer files arrive.
marta: Social draft: "Surfline cut p99 by ~75% after moving to Redwood Dedicated, unlocking real-time personalization. Read more -> <link>" Add parenthetical p99 numbers on the case page.
carla: Target publish Wed 9am PT. Diego, ensure headshot + logo uploaded by Mon EOD. Create HubSpot routing: tag=surfline-case -> assign Growth SDRs.
diego: Headshot + logo received and uploaded to /marketing/case-studies/surfline/assets/. assets-bot: uploaded headshot-400x400.jpg, logo-srgb.svg, banner-1200x628.png.
marta: Final copy done. Social scheduled for Wed 9am PT; routing rule created.
carla: Great shipping checklist: legal approval (done), customer signoff (done), assets (done), content scheduled. Thanks team!
